title: The C Major Scale
body: A scale is a set of notes arranged in order of pitch. C major uses every white key from C to C — no sharps, no flats. It's the foundation of Western music.

title: 8 Notes, One Octave
caption: C D E F G A B C — eight notes rising then returning. The last C is an octave higher than the first: same note, double the frequency.
